# YomVezman 0.6.1 preview
App 0.6.1 (7), Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later. Testing prerelease, not an App Store-approved release.
Native About YomVezman window with app icon, running version/build, developer information, Hebcal credits, bundled Sparkle license, website, privacy and support links. Available from the application and date-status menus. English/Hebrew layouts and expanded license checked visually; Escape and Done dismiss it. No calendar settings changed by About.
72 automated tests pass. Independent Swift review approved. Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled.
Acceptance remains partial: status-item-only About/calendar recovery, minimized-window recovery, permission denial, native Stop lookup activation, packaged same-process network outage/recovery, spoken VoiceOver and live link handoff remain unverified. Keep Dock mode enabled for the most thoroughly exercised launch path. This release does not close those RC gates.
From 0.4.0 or later: Check for Updates → Update → Install Update → Install and Relaunch. Older versions need one manual DMG installation. Publication does not replace your installed app.
